description: This course is designed to explore the complex challenges of leadership through the examination of individual leaders and workforce situations. title: Mezzo Practice
description: This practice course focuses on developing group leaders who possess both an understanding of group dynamics and effective leadership skills. The course provides a historical and theoretical framework for understanding social work practice with small groups. Emphasis will be placed on the development of social work skills in the context of group practice. The framework of the course is based on social work values and the ethical decision-making process, as illuminated by the NSAW Code of Ethics and the Standards for Social Work with Groups (Developed by the Association for the Advancement of Social Work with Groups (AASWG).
